summary: End-to-end testing of MissionBoard V1 MVP. Backend pytest suite (18 tests) all pass covering auth (cookie + bearer), role enforcement, skills/strategies seed, student linking, mission CRUD, mission log lifecycle and ordering. Frontend Playwright run validated parent login -> dashboard -> link-student -> create mission -> navigate to logs, and student login -> dashboard -> mission detail -> step completion -> reflection submit -> success screen -> parent sees the new log. Demo accounts and the 2 seeded missions for today are present.

minor.issue: CORS configured with allow_origins='*' AND allow_credentials=True. The CORSMiddleware will still echo Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which browsers reject when withCredentials is true. Worked in preview because the ingress likely rewrites the Origin or because requests are same-origin via the preview URL, but it is spec-non-compliant and will break if the frontend is served from a different origin. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to an explicit list (e.g. FRONTEND_URL from .env).
No Pydantic validation that steps list is non-empty or that due_date is a valid ISO YYYY-MM-DD (typed as str). Backend accepts arbitrary date string; downstream filtering depends on lexical equality.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Recommend migrating to lifespan context for FastAPI >= 0.95.

ui_bugs.component: MissionDetail reflection 'I used one of the strategies'
ui_bugs.issue: Rendered as a <button> styled to look like a checkbox; not an actual <input type=checkbox>. Accessibility/semantics issue; screen readers won't announce checked state and Playwright page.check() does not work. Functionally toggling on click works.
Uses native browser date picker instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover component. Per design guidance preference, swap to shadcn calendar for consistent kid-friendly UI.

issues: Empty 'Step 1' placeholder remains and the form happily submits with zero steps after empty filter — consider requiring at least one non-empty step or disabling submit otherwise.

action_items: Tighten CORS: replace allow_origins='*' with explicit FRONTEND_URL when allow_credentials=True (browser-compatibility hardening).
Convert reflection-used-strategies button to a true accessible checkbox (or shadcn Checkbox) so it is semantically correct and testable via standard checkbox APIs.
Consider switching the mission due_date input to a shadcn Calendar/Popover for design consistency.
Add server-side validation that due_date matches YYYY-MM-DD and (optionally) that steps has >=1 non-empty entry.
Replace deprecated @app.on_event with FastAPI lifespan context.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth implementation is solid: bcrypt hashing ($2b$), httpOnly + secure + samesite=none cookie, JWT 7-day expiry, get_current_user supports both cookie and Authorization Bearer (good for testing). Seed updates demo passwords idempotently if .env changes.
Role enforcement is consistent via require_role dependency; _assert_parent_owns_student gating mission access is correct.
Mongo _id excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
Delete mission also deletes associated logs — good cascade.
Logs sorted by timestamp desc — matches spec.
server.py is ~600 lines mixing models, routes, and seed. Acceptable for MVP but should be split (routers/, models.py, seed.py) as features grow.
test_credentials: parent@demo.com / demo1234 (parent, linked to Enzo); student@demo.com / demo1234 (student Enzo). Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates TEST_ prefixed users + 1 mission then deletes it. Playwright run created 'PWT_mission_isolated' which was then cleaned up via curl. Final state: only the 2 seeded demo missions for today remain for Enzo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_missionboard.py. Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_missionboard.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Demo missions are seeded only if NONE exist for Enzo today, so deleting them will re-trigger seed on next backend restart. Auth uses httpOnly cookie 'access_token' (samesite=none, secure=true) — use requests.Session() to persist cookies. The reflection used-strategies element is a <button> not a checkbox, use .click() not .check() in playwright.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. Initial playwright run had a false 'mission form did not redirect' failure caused by the form being submitted without any step text and the test timing — re-running with a non-empty step confirmed POST /api/missions returns 200 and the SPA navigates to /parent correctly. All endpoints respond as specified.
